# oauth2-pkce-client

> OAuth 2.0 authorization code client with PKCE S256, constant-time state check, bounded token parsing and single-refresh token renewal over an injected transport Python package `trysac-oauth2-pkce-client`, import name `oauth2_pkce_client`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
